phase_intent: pipeline validation; Phase 1 retargets to Qwen3.8-27B when it is published
hermes_dialect_evidence: the repository's own tokenizer_config chat template emits <tool_call>, <tools>, <tool_response> and <think>, and does not emit <scratch_pad>
kv_bytes_per_token_note: Over the 16 FULL-ATTENTION layers only. This model is hybrid: layer_types is 48 linear_attention + 16 full_attention, so 48 of 64 layers keep a fixed per-sequence recurrent state instead of a per-token KV cache. The previous value here, 262144, used 2*64*4*256*2 -- every layer -- and overstated the per-token cost by 4x. That matters because kv_bytes() sizes a VRAM budget against a card, and a 4x overstatement rules out hardware that in fact runs this model comfortably.

kv_bytes_measured.source: vLLM 0.26.0 on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, 2026-08-10
kv_bytes_measured.note: Measured total is slightly above the 65536 derived here because vLLM's KV pool accounting also carries the linear-attention layers' per-sequence state. That state does not scale with context length, so it belongs in a per-sequence budget rather than a per-token one -- which is why the derived figure, not this one, is what kv_bytes() multiplies by a context length.
